contents.content: There are 10-15 questions. There is no time limit.

_data.content:
This test will check what you have learned in this lesson.
  • Talk about myths and legends.
  • Talk about things that happened.
  • Talk about things that are being done or have been done. (passive of present continuous tense and present perfect passive)
  • Talk about how to quote other people.
  • Talk about reactions and behaviors in different situations. (past simple and past continuous)
Rapunzel has been given a beautiful gift that she would never lose.
The men have been told not to come back without a wife.
A single tear has been shed by the princess and his sight had been restored.
The crown has been stolen never to be found again.
The witch isn't being persuaded to remove her cloak.
The trees aren't being chopped down because they have magical properties.
The princess isn't being allowed to leave the tower.
